meta.title: 三个技巧教你如何在提示词里控制AI光线
meta.title_en: 3 Prompts to Control Light in AI Images

scenes.title_cn: 开场：你的AI图之所以假，是因为你不…
scenes.title_en: Opening: your AI images look fake because …
scenes.context: 光线是AI图的真实感关键。
sentences: 你的AI图之所以假，是因为你不会控制光线。
Your AI images look fake because you can't control the light.
look fake（显得假）
光线是AI图最容易露馅的地方。
Light is the easiest place for AI images to give themselves away.
give themselves away（露馅）
scenes.speak: Your AI images look fake because you can't control the light. Light is the easiest place for AI images to give themselves away.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧一·确定光的方向：别只写影视灯光…
scenes.title_en: Trick one · set the light direction: don't…
scenes.context: 给光一个明确来源与方向。
sentences: 首先我们要确定光的方向，别只写影视灯光，这种太笼统，AI根本不知道光从哪来。
First set the light direction—don't just write cinematic lighting, it's too vague for AI.
too vague（太笼统）
我们要让光有来源，要写光的进场方向。
Give the light a source and describe its entry direction.
light source（光源）
要描述阴影布局，让画面变得立体，这样质感就出来了。
Describe the shadow layout to add dimension and texture.
shadow layout（阴影布局）
scenes.speak: First set the light direction—don't just write cinematic lighting, it's too vague for AI. Give the light a source and describe its entry direction. Describe the shadow layout to add dimension and texture.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧二·控制光的比例：AI默认会把画…
scenes.title_en: Trick two · control the light ratio: AI fi…
scenes.context: 明确光影比例，避免全亮无深度。
sentences: AI默认会把画面打得很满，这样会让画面没深度。
AI fills the frame bright by default, which kills depth.
no depth（没深度）
正确写法是告诉AI具体哪里亮、哪里暗，这样才有对比。
The right prompt tells AI exactly where's bright and where's dark.
bright and dark（亮暗）
我们要明确光影的比例，真实感就靠亮暗对比撑起来的。
Make the light ratio explicit—realism rides on contrast.
light ratio（光影比例）
scenes.speak: AI fills the frame bright by default, which kills depth. The right prompt tells AI exactly where's bright and where's dark. Make the light ratio explicit—realism rides on contrast.

scenes.title_cn: 技巧三·控制色温：色温就是画面的情绪…
scenes.title_en: Trick three · control the color temperatur…
sentences: 第三，我们要控制色温，色温就是画面的情绪。
Third, control the white balance—it's the mood of the frame.
white balance（色温）
偏冷像清晨的雾，偏暖像曝晒的风。
Cool is like morning mist, warm is like midday heat.
morning mist（清晨的雾）
用冷暖交错的光线，让画面有情绪感，不再死板。
Interweave cool and warm light for emotion instead of flatness.
cool and warm（冷暖交错）
scenes.speak: Third, control the white balance—it's the mood of the frame. Cool is like morning mist, warm is like midday heat. Interweave cool and warm light for emotion instead of flatness.

scenes.title_cn: 总结：记住这三步——方向、光比、色温…
sentences: 所以记住这三步：方向、光比、色温。
So remember these three steps: direction, ratio, color temperature.
three steps（三步）
下一期，教你怎么写反光、体积光、补光层次的提示词。
Next episode: prompts for reflections, volume light, and fill-light layers.
volume light（体积光）
scenes.speak: So remember these three steps: direction, ratio, color temperature. Next episode: prompts for reflections, volume light, and fill-light layers.

practice: Describe where the light enters the frame.
Tell AI exactly which parts are bright and dark.
Interweave cool and warm light for emotion.
Add direction, ratio, and temperature in one prompt.
pitfalls: Specify the light direction and entry angle.
影视灯光太笼统，AI不知道光从哪来。
Let AI fill the frame bright.
State exactly where's bright and where's dark.
AI默认全亮，要明确光影比例才有对比。
色温是情绪，冷暖交错才不死板。
Cram every effect into one prompt.
Combine direction, ratio, and temperature coherently.
方向+光比+色温组合，逻辑要连贯。
shifts: 用 light source（光源）、entry direction（进场方向）、shadow layout（阴影布局）
用 color temperature（色温）、morning mist（晨雾）、midday heat（正午曝晒）
footer_notes: 转录基于图文实录完整口播。已校正：控制光线、影视灯光、光的来源、进场方向、阴影布局、立体、质感、画面打得很满、哪里亮哪里暗、光影比例、亮暗对比、色温、情绪、清晨的雾、曝晒的风、冷暖交错、死板、免费提示词等。
